tool.name: OGS: createIntermediateRasters
tool.command: ln -sf '$file2' 'file2.asc'; ln -sf '$file1' 'file1.asc'; createIntermediateRasters #if str($number) --number '$number' #end if --file2 'file2.asc' --file1 'file1.asc' --output-file output_.asc

param.label: number
param.help: number of rasters to be calculated

tool.help: Takes two DEMs located at the exact same spatial position (but at different elevation) and calculates n raster DEMs located at equidistant intervals between them (i.e. for n=1, one new raster located precisely in the middle will be created).
